//: THE LOCALE SET IS DATA, NOT A UNION TYPE (SA §TS-12.2 rule 5, SD §FE-10). This file mirrors the `locale_registry` table of SD §DB-... verbatim, column for column, and db/seed/ seeds the table from it. Adding Turkish (PM Q9/Q10) or a visitor-segment language (PM Q14) is a row here plus a translation programme — it is never a codebase-wide type change. `is_safety_language` is where the honest cost is stated: a fourth SAFETY locale needs a lexicon, a red-team, an operator on every shift and a full safety_critical catalogue; a fourth UI locale does not.
